NONE: › If your arm or leg is asleep, it cannot feel anything because it has been in the same position for so long.
（手臂或腿長時間維持一種姿勢而）發麻的，麻木的

example: I'm surprised to see you awake - ten minutes ago you were fast/sound (= completely) asleep.
真奇怪，你怎麼醒了——十分鐘前你還睡得很甜呢。
I've only just got up and I'm still half asleep (= not completely awake).
我剛起床，還沒完全醒呢。
I fell asleep as soon as my head hit the pillow.
我頭一放在枕頭上，就睡著了。
